title: Murmuration
description: A starling flock pours over a reedbed under a pale dusk sky. Your pointer is the hawk: fly at the flock and it tears open, a dark wave runs through it, and it folds back together behind you.
intent: One living thing with consequence and no chrome: a real flocking model whose birds bank, flap and roll in 3D, so the dark bands of a murmuration come from birds turning edge-on, and fear passes bird to bird as a wave.

sources.name: three.js, GPGPU birds
sources.what: Ported to the CPU with a grid hash (MIT): the separation, alignment and cohesion zones (20/20/20) with their cosine curves, the flattened centre pull, the predator radius 150 and push, the speed limit 9 plus 5 when fleeing, and the wing-phase rule.

sources.name: Bruno Simon, folio 2025 day cycles
sources.what: The dusk palette (fog #3e53ff to #ff4ce4, light #ff8181), toned toward paper for the sky.

sources.name: darkroom.engineering, Lenis
sources.what: The frame-rate-independent damp that the hawk follows the pointer with.

sources.name: Procaccini et al., Propagating waves in starling murmurations (2011)
sources.what: The agitation wave: fear relayed bird to bird and shown as birds rolling, not as a colour change.
